$comment: Display -> spoken forms. Captions always show the display text; the TTS engine is given the spoken form, and the spoken-word timings are mapped back onto the display tokens (pipeline/voice/pronunciation.py, timing.map_to_display). 'spoken' is a plain-English respelling so it works with every engine (Kokoro and Piper both phonemize with espeak-ng). Matching is case-insensitive unless "case": true. Multi-word entries match across consecutive tokens. Per-project additions go in the project's voice.pronunciation {display: spoken} and win over these. This shared file holds only brand-neutral terms. Brand names and domains live in brands/<id>/pronunciation.json (merged per production; project entries win) and MUST be confirmed by ear.
